Specifically, Jake suggests that Li Hua should consume a snack rich in both carbohydrates and protein. One practical example he provides is a combination of a banana with peanut butter. This snack provides the necessary nutrients to help rebuild muscle tissue and replenish glycogen stores, while also providing a good balance of simple and complex carbohydrates. Alongside this, Jake highlights the need for adequate hydration, recommending water or an electrolyte drink to replace fluids lost through sweat during the game. Additionally, he suggests incorporating stretching exercises to help ease muscle tension and facilitate recovery.
